annotations.text: Every door into DiveDay is one shell (EntryShell), spoken in Clearwater: one column, one act, quiet footer links. The terminal glyph is drawn, never an emoji. Dead links split into two tiers, now law: an account token (verify, reset, invite) never names a shop; a booking token (waiver, ready, recap, claim) always offers the shop's hand. Claim leaves its hand-rolled grammar and joins the diver's thread — its success already lands on /ready.

The first morning is a state of the home, never a wizard — H-62's grammar applied to day zero. Three presence-derived ledger rows (first dive site, first departure, payments) each leave forever when their fact becomes true; zero new columns, nothing to dismiss. The first booking ever carries the coral mark — the staff side's single entry in the coral budget — and with the second, the home is just the home. Fiction: June Okafor opens Torchlight Divers, Islamorada, on Tue Sep 1.
